data.comment: The folder question asked on the first capture, when the box was left empty.

data.name: SettingsFirstRunProtected
data.value: Windows, Shotwin'in oraya yazmasına izin vermez — burası Denetimli Klasör Erişimi'nin koruduğu klasörlerden biri. Başka birini seç ya da varsayılanı kullan.
data.comment: The folder question asked on the first capture, when the chosen folder is protected. Controlled Folder Access is a Windows feature name.

data.name: SettingsFirstRunSubtitle
data.value: İlk karen hazır. Şimdi bir klasör seç, bundan sonra o kullanılır — sonra Ayarlar'dan değiştirebilirsin.
data.comment: The folder question asked on the first capture, the line under its heading.

data.name: SettingsFirstRunTitle
data.comment: Heading of the folder question asked on the first capture.

data.name: SettingsFirstRunUnwritable
data.value: Shotwin oraya yazamıyor. Yolu denetle ya da varsayılanı kullan.
data.comment: The folder question asked on the first capture, when the chosen folder refused a test write.

data.name: SettingsFirstRunUse
data.comment: The folder question asked on the first capture: button that accepts the typed folder.

data.name: SettingsFolder
data.comment: Label over the save folder box, in Settings and in the question asked on the first capture.

data.name: SettingsFolderOpenFailed
data.comment: Settings page, when Windows refused to open the save folder.

data.name: SettingsFolderProtected
data.value: Windows Denetimli Klasör Erişimi bu klasörü koruyor, bu yüzden Shotwin buraya yazamıyor. Kareler yedek klasöre gidiyor — hiçbir şey kaybolmuyor. Bu klasörün kullanılmasını istiyorsan Shotwin'e Windows Güvenliği'nde izin ver.
data.comment: Settings page, under the save folder box when the folder is protected. Controlled Folder Access and Windows Security are Windows feature names.

data.name: SettingsFolderUnwritable
data.value: Shotwin bu klasöre yazamıyor, kareler yedek klasöre gidiyor. Yolu ve oraya yazma iznin olduğunu denetle.
data.comment: Settings page, under the save folder box when a write failed for any other reason.

data.name: SettingsLanguage
data.comment: Settings page, label beside the language list under SYSTEM.

data.name: SettingsLanguageAutomatic
data.comment: Settings page, first entry in the language list: use whatever display language Windows is set to. Every other entry is a language written in its own words and is never translated.

data.name: SettingsNextFile
data.comment: Settings page, a worked example under the file name box. {0} is the name the template produces right now.

data.name: SettingsOpen
data.comment: Settings page, button that opens the save folder in Explorer.

data.name: SettingsOpenEditor
data.comment: Settings page, tick box under AFTER CAPTURE.

data.name: SettingsOverlayHeader
data.comment: Settings page, section heading over the capture overlay options. Upper case in English.

data.name: SettingsPreviewAppears
data.comment: Settings page, label beside the list of corners the preview thumbnail can appear in.

data.name: SettingsPreviewHint
data.value: Önizleme, bir kareyi oradan aldığın yerdir: düzenlemek için tıkla, PNG'yi bırakmak için herhangi bir uygulamaya sürükle ya da alt kenarındaki düğmeleri kullan. Başka bir pencereye geçince kaybolur, kareyi panoda yapıştırmaya hazır bırakır. Otomatik kaydetme kapalıyken, önizlemede Kaydet'e basmazsan kare atılır.
data.comment: Settings page, the paragraph explaining the preview thumbnail. PNG is a file format name.

data.name: SettingsSaved
data.comment: Settings page, the confirmation that floats over the bottom of the list after a change is written.

data.name: SettingsSavingHeader
data.comment: Settings page, section heading over the folder and file name options. Upper case in English.

data.name: SettingsSecurityDone
data.value: Tamam. Shotwin artık o klasöre yazabiliyor.
data.comment: Settings page, after Windows Security accepted the app and the folder now takes writes.

data.name: SettingsSecurityStillBlocked
data.value: Windows değişikliği kabul etti ama klasör hâlâ yazmayı reddediyor.
data.comment: Settings page, after Windows Security accepted the app but the folder still refuses writes.

data.name: SettingsShowCoordinates
data.comment: Settings page, tick box under OVERLAY.

data.name: SettingsShowPreview
data.comment: Settings page, tick box under AFTER CAPTURE.

data.name: SettingsSnapWindows
data.comment: Settings page, tick box under OVERLAY.

data.name: SettingsStartupHint
data.value: Pencere açmadan doğrudan bildirim alanında başlar.
data.comment: Settings page, under the start-at-login tick box.

data.name: SettingsStartupRefused
data.value: Windows, oturum açınca başlatma değişikliğini reddetti.

data.name: SettingsStartWithWindows
data.comment: Settings page, tick box under SYSTEM.

data.name: SettingsSubtitle
data.comment: Settings page, the line under its heading.

data.comment: Settings page, section heading over the language and start-at-login options. Upper case in English.

data.name: SettingsTitle

data.name: SettingsWaitingForAdmin

data.name: ShortcutsGrabText

data.comment: Shortcuts page, what the scrolling shortcut does.

data.name: ShortcutsTitle
data.comment: Shortcuts page, its heading.

data.name: TrayCaptureArea
data.comment: Notification area menu item that opens the area overlay.

data.name: TrayCaptureScreen
data.comment: Notification area menu item that grabs the monitor the cursor is on.

data.name: TrayColourCopied
data.comment: Notification after the colour picker. {0} is the colour value, for example #1B1B1F.

data.name: TrayCrash
data.comment: Notification after an error the app recovered from. {0} is the message from Windows, {1} is the path of the log file. Neither is translated.

data.name: TrayFileUnreadable
data.comment: Notification when a saved shot could not be decoded to reopen it.

data.name: TrayGrabText
data.comment: Notification area menu item that reads the text out of a region.

data.name: TrayNoText
data.comment: Notification when text recognition ran on a captured region and read nothing.

data.name: TrayOpen
data.comment: Notification area menu item that shows the main window.

data.name: TrayPickColour
data.comment: Notification area menu item that opens the colour loupe.

data.name: TrayQuit
data.comment: Notification area menu item that ends the app.

data.name: TrayRecent
data.comment: Notification area menu item that opens the gallery of saved shots.

data.name: TraySaveFailed
data.comment: Notification when automatic saving failed. {0} is the reason, from ErrorSaveBlocked or from Windows.

data.name: TrayScrollingCapture
data.comment: Notification area menu item that starts a scrolling capture.

data.name: TraySettings
data.comment: Notification area menu item that opens the settings page.

data.comment: Shown when another app holds the clipboard.

data.comment: Shown after the file is put on the clipboard.

data.name: VideoCopy
data.comment: Video editor button that copies the file itself.

data.name: VideoCutCount_One
data.comment: How many stretches are being dropped. {0} is the number, here one.

data.name: VideoCutCount_Many
data.comment: How many stretches are being dropped. {0} is the number, two or more.

data.comment: Tooltip on the small cross that undoes one cut.
